_comment: PRELIMINARY — needs verification against the Aranya Bhavana
office order / section allocation before it is wired into the build.
Maps CCMS 'user' rows (the section+post pairs the report returns for
the HQ departments) to the wing/unit they sit under at Aranya Bhavana.
Keys under 'sections' are the CCMS section string EXACTLY as it comes
back in the report — including the case and double-space quirks — the
same rule as circles.json. Match is on section first; where one section
string is split across wings, add a 'post' qualifier.
'_unmapped' holds rows that are NOT an Aranya Bhavana wing: field
offices whose users were created under the HQ department code, and the
CCMS Admin account under PCCFHead Of Forest Force.

Personnel & Recruitment.head: APCCF (Personnel & Recruitment)
Personnel & Recruitment._note: Establishment (gazetted and non-gazetted) sits under this wing, not under Admin & Coord.

field_offices_under_hq_code.label: Field offices under HQ code
field_offices_under_hq_code._note: Users belonging to territorial/WL field offices but created under the Aranya Bhavana department code. Data-hygiene issue to raise with CCMS Admin, not a wing.

system_accounts.label: System account / unallocated
system_accounts._note: Sits under the PCCFHead Of Forest Force department, not a wing. Cases parked here are unallocated.

_known_duplicates: Same wing, two CCMS user records differing only in case — merge in display.
